description: Research keyword data (search volume, difficulty, CPC, related ideas) for 1-5 seed keywords in one call — one research run per seed. Returns `results`, one entry per seed with `ok` — a single bad seed won't fail the batch. CHARGES CREDITS ON THE PAID DATA PROVIDER: per seed, ~30-100 credits each depending on the source, or a flat ~96 for countries served from Google Ads data (where difficulty and intent are unavailable). On the default free provider the sources are autocomplete plus the operator's own Keyword Planner account and NOTHING IS CHARGED — but volume/CPC/competition are null unless the operator configured a Keyword Planner, and null there means not measured, never zero demand. Keyword difficulty is derived for the SEED keyword only — every other returned row has a null difficulty because it was never scored, not because it is easy. Each seed returns `rowCount` (every row found) but only `topRows`, the first 20, are included in the response; say 20 when reporting what you actually saw, and use list_saved_keywords or the dashboard for the rest.

includeClickstreamData.description: Refine search volumes with clickstream data, which disaggregates Google Ads' grouped close-variant volumes (plurals/misspellings). On the paid DataForSEO provider this DOUBLES the credit cost of each seed. Default false (standard Google-Ads-derived volumes). Ignored — no cost, no effect — for countries served from Google Ads data, and on the free data provider, whose autocomplete + Keyword Planner sources have no clickstream refinement at all.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

resultLimit.description: Cap on the data provider's own rows per seed. Defaults to 150. It is NOT a cap on `rowCount`: free Google Suggest ideas are appended after the cap is applied, so a seed can legitimately report more rows than this number.

seeds.description: 1-5 seed keywords. Each seed is researched independently and returns related keywords with volume/difficulty/CPC. Bulk-friendly — prefer this over multiple single-seed calls.

languageCode.description: Language code (e.g. 'en', 'es', 'fr'). Omit it to use the project's default market language, which falls back to 'en'.

locationCode.description: DataForSEO location code. Omit it to use the project's default market, which falls back to 2840 (United States) for a project that has not set one. See dataforseo.com/help-center/locations. Some countries (e.g. Iceland, 2352) are served from Google Ads data: keyword volume/CPC/trends work, but keyword difficulty, search intent, and domain analytics are unavailable.

name: research_keywords
